name: historical-champions
description: Historical Champions - 2.5D historical fighting game (web + Android via Capacitor)

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run verify:assets
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:release-apk: npm run cap:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleRelease
scripts.android:bundle: npm run cap:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs bundleRelease
